eyebrow: Wood, craftsmanship and attention to detail
heroTitle: Spaces with character, made to last
heroText: We design and craft bespoke furniture, kitchens and carpentry solutions that truly fit your space and the way you live.
imageNote: Crafted with care. Made to last.
aboutTitle: Traditional craftsmanship with a contemporary outlook
aboutText: Every project starts by listening: how you use your space, what you need to store and the atmosphere you want to create. We bring together thoughtful design, responsible material choices and precise workmanship to make practical, lasting pieces.
servicesIntro: Personalised solutions that make better use of every space and give it character.
service1Text: Tables, shelving, sideboards and distinctive pieces designed for your space.
service2Text: Smart storage, quality fittings and durable finishes for everyday use.
service3Text: Doors, panelling, flooring and integrated woodwork to refresh an entire space.
processTitle: A straightforward process, with support at every step
step1Text: We learn about your ideas, measurements, needs and indicative budget.
step2Text: We prepare a clear proposal for materials, finishes and technical solutions.
step3Text: Each element is made in the workshop with care for fit and finish.
step4Text: We install the work, check every detail and leave the space ready to enjoy.
valuesTitle: Building better, with care and respect for the material
contactTitle: Have a space that needs something special?
contactText: Tell us what you have in mind. We'll get back to you with the questions needed for an initial outline.
contactNote: Serving your area and nearby locations.
footerText: Contemporary carpentry, crafted with skill and designed to last.
demoNote: Demonstration website. Contact details are fictional.
